title: Casper and the Playlist
premise: Noor Montrose has spent two years at Ashgrove Academy being invisible, until a forced pairing with her nemesis, golden-boy Casper Vale, on a music-history project drags them into the academy's buried secret: the school's legendary 'Playlist,' an archive that lets whoever controls it rewrite students' records, futures, and loyalties. As Noor and Casper dig deeper, they discover the championship everyone obsesses over is a distraction engineered by Headmistress Crane to keep the Playlist's power concentrated in few hands. To break it, they must enter and win both competitions — the one that doesn't matter and the one that decides everything — while falling for each other against every rule of survival Noor has ever written. In the end they expose the archive publicly at the championship final, sacrificing Casper's legacy and Noor's scholarship safety to free the school, choosing each other and belonging over the system that promised them security.
about_author: Zephyrine Underhill is a former boarding-school music librarian who swears half her stories are fiction. She writes from a cluttered attic full of obsolete mixtapes and insists every villain is just someone who was once left off a playlist.

chapters.title: Assigned Seating
chapters.summary: Noor's POV. When music teacher Mr. Okafor pairs Noor with Casper Vale — the boy who got her middle-school friend expelled — for a semester project on 'sound and power,' she plans to do the work alone and vanish. But their first archive session uncovers a locked sub-basement vault humming with old recordings labeled with student names. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance crackling with resentment and unwanted curiosity.

chapters.title: The Vault Remembers
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Noor and Casper breach the vault and find the Playlist: recordings that can alter transcripts, recommendations, even memories of who someone was. They realize Casper's own admission was manufactured — and Noor's scholarship is leverage held by Headmistress Crane. Caught between blackmail and alliance, they agree to secretly compete in the Solstice Championship to get close to Crane's inner circle. Emotional beat: fear hardening into purpose; trust's first fragile stitch.

chapters.title: Everything Louder Than Everything Else
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Training montage turns betrayal: Crane offers Casper his family's restored name if he hands over Noor, and he pretends to accept to protect her — but Noor overhears half the conversation and believes the worst. At the semifinal, Crane activates the Playlist live, rewriting a rival student into a shell, and Noor sees what winning really costs. Emotional beat: heartbreak, guilt, and the sickening glamour of corrupted power.

chapters.title: Track One
chapters.summary: Dual POV converging. At the championship final, Noor and Casper reconcile mid-performance and hijack the broadcast: instead of competing, they play the vault's original recordings — every erased student's true voice — over the academy's speakers. The Playlist's spell breaks as the audience remembers; Crane falls when her own altered history plays back. Noor loses her scholarship cover but gains something rarer: a school that finally sees her, and Casper, choosing her openly. Emotional beat: catharsis, sacrifice transformed into belonging.
